syn: ip [ ip-OPTIONS ] route { COMMAND | help } ⏎ ip route { show | flush } SELECTOR ⏎ ip route save SELECTOR ⏎ ip route restore ⏎ ip route get ROUTE_GET_FLAGS [ to ] ADDRESS [ from ADDRESS iif STRING ] [ oif STRING ] [ mark MARK ] [ tos TOS ] [ vrf NAME ] [ ipproto PROTOCOL ] [ sport NUMBER ] [ dport NUMBER ] [ as ADDRESS ] [ flowlabel FLOWLABEL ] ⏎ ip route { add | del | change | append | replace } ROUTE

show.es: Muestra la tabla de rutas (por defecto).

add.es: AÑADE una ruta (p. ej. «add default via 192.168.1.1»).

get.es: Muestra qué ruta se usaría para un destino.
get.en: Show which route would be used for a destination.
